tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Quick coverage catalog of countries and trade blocs: ISO code, region, headline and available data topics. For one country's facts, call get_country_profile; this tool does not return visa or index details.

tools.name: find_visas
tools.description: Filter the digital-nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visa datasets by entry minimum, type, region, presence and citizenship time; results sort by lowest minimum within each type. This is the numeric filter for those three visa families. For natural-language search across the broader reside

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description: One-country roll-up: a summary plus the available visa, citizenship, tax, banking, property-tax, cost-of-living, safety, healthcare, passport, expat-index and blacklist data. Pass topics to limit the response because a full profile can be large. Use compare_countries for the same topic across countr

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full record for one named or selected residency, visa or citizenship program. Returns a canonical summary plus sourced requirements, income or investment minimum, stay rules, permanent-residency and citizenship timelines, government fees, processing time, legal basis and verification dates. Use sear

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Free-text search across the full immigration catalog, including visas, residency-to-permanent-residency and citizenship pathways. Natural-language aliases such as "golden visa", "property residency", "pension visa" and "remote work visa" are recognized. Returns compact matches with reasons and progr

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare two or more countries on one available dataset topic, such as tax_systems, banking or cost_of_living. Returns the matching source rows side by side; use a specialized compare tool for passport, crypto, freedom or city-safety rankings.

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Compare 2–8 immigration programs, including programs from different countries. Returns a compact side-by-side view of minimum income or investment, citizenship time, stay requirement, processing time, government fee, tax context and links. Find candidates with search_programs or find_visas, then pas

tools.name: get_settlement_blocs
tools.description: Cross-border residence rights based on nationality under the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement, Andean Migratory Statute and CARICOM free movement. Returns conditions, permanent-residency timelines, legal sources and eligible passports. Pass a country to see which agreements its citizens may use; these a

tools.name: find_private_clubs
tools.description: Search the sourced club directory for country, city, yacht and hybrid clubs. Returns membership/access notes, reciprocity, facilities, official links, sources and verification dates. Use club_type=golf to find directory clubs whose verified facilities mention golf. This is club discovery, not a golf

tools.name: find_golf_courses
tools.description: Search MyLatinLife's 40-course editorial ranking by country, city, access category or words. Results stay in published rank order and include the rationale, access notes and sources. Phone, email, contact-page and booking fields appear only when verified. Use find_private_clubs for the broader club

tools.name: compare_passports
tools.description: Compare the published passport-power index for selected countries, including visa-free access, US ESTA eligibility, regional settlement rights and MyLatinLife's score. Omit countries for the full ranking; use compare_countries with topic=passport_power for the underlying country rows.

tools.name: check_military_service
tools.description: Country-level military-service and conscription exposure, including considerations for an adult who naturalizes and for their children, with the governing sources. This is a country research summary, not an individual legal determination.

tools.name: find_firearm_rules
tools.description: Country-level summary of firearm ownership and carry rules relevant to foreign residents, including minimum age, regulator, cited law and sources. It does not determine an individual permit application or authorize possession.

tools.name: compare_crypto_adoption
tools.description: Compare two separate views of crypto by country: grassroots adoption and investor mobility. Their scores and methods remain separate; do not treat the investor assessment as a measure of everyday use.

tools.name: compare_freedom
tools.description: Compare human, personal and economic freedom scores and global ranks, including countries that were not rated.

tools.name: compare_city_safety
tools.description: Search MyLatinLife's city Safety Index by country or city. City scores start with the country index plus documented city adjustments; they are comparative editorial estimates, not real-time crime data or a neighborhood-level guarantee.

tools.name: find_renunciation_rules
tools.description: Country rules on whether a citizen by birth can renounce nationality, with legal basis and any distinction for naturalized citizens. This is separate from citizenship-by-descent eligibility and does not submit a renunciation application.

tools.name: find_sovereignty_projects
tools.description: Search a directory of charter cities, special economic zones, micronations, network states and related sovereignty experiments. Filter by words, region, project status or category; the directory does not imply legal sovereignty or government recognition.

tools.name: find_nomad_events
tools.description: Search the dated event calendar for digital-nomad conferences, festivals, cruises, workations and related events. Use date filters to find events within a period; check the organizer source for current schedules and availability.

tools.name: check_citizenship_by_descent
tools.description: Screen one country for possible citizenship eligibility through a parent, grandparent or great-grandparent. Returns the generation rule, likely timeline, difficulty, document pointers and country guide. This is an initial screen, not a legal determination; ancestry facts and records still need revie

tools.name: calculate_residency_return
tools.description: Calculate a conservative return-by date from the last day in country under the supported Panama and Paraguay residency-maintenance rules. The calculation uses the day before the calendar anniversary. It is limited to the listed residency types; it does not calculate presence for other countries or c

tools.name: count_travel_days
tools.description: Count inclusive calendar days per country and calendar year, deduplicate overlapping trips, and report each country's maximum in any rolling 365-day window. Use this general travel log for country-presence tracking; use calculate_feie_days for the US tax test. Each entry is Country|arrival|departure

tools.name: calculate_feie_days
tools.description: Apply the US Foreign Earned Income Exclusion physical-presence day-count method to travel entries, including the best rolling 12-month window. This is the tax-specific calculation, not the general by-country travel summary in count_travel_days. Each entry is arrival|departure|type, where type is us,

tools.name: estimate_tax_savings
tools.description: Run the same simplified effective-rate scenario as the website Tax Savings Calculator for selected origin, income, subdivision and income type. This is a directional model, not a tax-return calculation; it omits deductions, credits, sourcing, payroll/self-employment tax, treaties, destination-countr

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Bulk export of every row in one dataset, optionally limited to one country. Use this to import a topic into a product or workflow, not to look up one answer; ordinary search and comparison tools return complete results without a key. Bulk exports require a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log for tracked datasets, newest first. Includes changed program facts (with old and new values), tax-list additions/removals and changes in what MyLatinLife covers. Dates show when MLL recorded a dataset change, not when a law took effect or a government announced a policy.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Retrieve recently published MyLatinLife articles and guides, newest first, with URL, dates and excerpt. Optionally match words in the title. This searches MLL content; it is not a news search across the web.

tools.name: find_mll_service
tools.description: Find a MyLatinLife service when someone wants help handling a residency, citizenship, banking, tax, document or company application. Returns service name, page and whether it starts online or with a consultation call; it does not return prices. Filter by country, service-name words or both.

tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Find videos from MyLatinLife's YouTube catalog, newest first, about residency, citizenship, banking, tax, cost of living and life in Latin America. Optionally filter by country or words in the title; this searches MLL's channel, not all YouTube.

tools.name: about_data
tools.description: API orientation: dataset names, descriptions, row counts, verification-date ranges, country coverage, change-log start date, usage terms and citation instructions. Use this first to see whether the API contains the topic you need.

tools.name: check_tax_blacklists
tools.description: Check whether a country or jurisdiction appears on tracked tax and AML blacklists or greylists, including EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF and selected national lists. Returns list status, dates, legal basis and stated consequences; this is distinct from the separate FATF greylist taxonomy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_latest_articles · Private data: find_visas, get_country_profile, get_program, search_programs, find_private_clubs, find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_dataset, find_mll_service · Public sink: find_golf_courses, find_renunciation_rules · Destructive: estimate_tax_savings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_latest_articles · Private data: find_visas, get_country_profile, get_program, search_programs, find_private_clubs, find_golf_courses, check_citizenship_by_descent, get_dataset, find_mll_service · Public sink: find_golf_courses, find_renunciation_rules · Destructive: estimate_tax_savings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
